execution_classes.HISTORICAL_BACKTEST: the rule measured on frozen bars by four engines
execution_classes.PAPER_REPLAY: historical bars driven through the runtime's own paper path: real execution of the code, not prospective observation
execution_classes.PROSPECTIVE_PAPER: not produced: the prospective slice is captured and reserved but has not accrued enough bars to be scored

ledger_identity.reading: every close the broker performed is in ``exits``, including the ones the engine performs inside its own cycle, and every opening the broker performed is in ``fills``, including the ones that never survived to a book snapshot. An opening with no close is a position still open when the replay ended, and its count is ``open_positions_at_end``

ledger_reconciliation.how: an opening is identified by symbol, instant and execution price rather than by a timestamp two openings can share, and every close is drained from the broker's own closed-trades ledger, so the closes the engine performs inside its own cycle are recorded too
